name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
eligibility: For the 2026-27 programme: resident Indian citizens who passed Class 12 with at least 60%, are in first year of a regular full-time undergraduate degree, and have household income below ₹15 lakh. A mandatory aptitude test is part of the process.
benefit: Up to ₹2 lakh over the duration of the degree programme.
deadline: 2026-27 applications are closed; verify the official page for future cycles.
